headline: Monday slate: ALCS Game 6 (Guardians @ Rays, Tampa leads 3-2), Commanders @ 49ers on Monday Night Football, WNBA Finals Game 2 (Dream @ Valkyries, Golden State leads 1-0), and NHL. The Brewers await in the World Series starting Friday.

record.label: Last board (Fri 10/16)
record.note: Washington won outright at Purdue (38-26), the Bruins won 4-2, and Lehkonen scored twice. José Ramírez went 0-for-3 and the Penguins lost 5-2. Third winning board in a row.

notes: No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and nothing on this board is above a 3.
Sources split on several games today (the MNF total, WNBA Game 2, the Sharks-Leafs and Penguins-Mammoth totals). We skipped or downsized those.
Odds move. Skip any pick whose price is past the 'playable to' number in its reasoning. Prices marked 'estimate' weren't confirmed at a book — check yours.
Bet only what you can afford to lose. Help: 1-800-GAMBLER.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Friday these went 2-1. Today the Rays can close out the ALCS at home behind Peralta.

straight.reasoning: SI and Covers both pick Tampa. Freddy Peralta threw six scoreless innings against Cleveland in Game 2 and has allowed one run all postseason. Cleveland has to cover 27 outs with a bullpen game, since Gavin Williams isn't available, and its relievers are worn down. Tampa went 55-26 at home and has outscored Cleveland 10-4 over the last two games. Playable to -160.

78% of spread bets are on San Francisco, but the line hasn't moved off 7.5 and the price has shifted toward Washington, which usually means bigger bettors are on the Commanders. Washington is +5 in turnovers with only two giveaways. The 49ers are missing Nick Bosa and Deebo Samuel, their receiver room is decimated, and their kicker has missed five kicks. Risk: SF is 3-0 against the spread at home. Playable to +7; skip at +6.5.

parlay.title: Monday Night Double
parlay.reasoning: The two best straight bets together; they start eight minutes apart. Pays about 2.1-to-1.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: ALCS Game 6: Guardians @ Rays, 5:08 PM PT on TBS. Tampa leads 3-2 after winning Games 4 (7-3) and 5 (3-1). Peralta vs a Cleveland bullpen game. Rays -147, total 6.5. The winner faces Milwaukee in the World Series starting Friday.

straight.reasoning: Peralta (one run allowed this postseason, six scoreless vs Cleveland in Game 2) against a tired Cleveland bullpen game, at home where Tampa went 55-26. SI and Covers agree. Playable to -160.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Monday Night Football: Commanders @ 49ers, 5:15 PM PT on ESPN/ABC. 49ers -7.5, total about 52 (up from 50.5). San Francisco is without Bosa and Deebo, Mike Evans is questionable, and its receiver room is down to depth players. We pass on the total, since Covers and Dimers like the Under and TheSpread likes the Over.

straight.reasoning: Line holding at 7.5 despite 78% of bets on SF, a +5 turnover margin, and a short-handed 49ers team. Skip at +6.5.

props.reasoning: With his receivers banged up, Purdy has topped his rushing line in four of five games. Covers projects 29.4 rushing yards, and Washington allows 19.4 per game to quarterbacks. Price is an estimate from a 44% market; skip below +110.

sections.label: Hockey
sections.slate: Monday card includes Avalanche @ Flyers (4:00 PM PT), Sharks @ Maple Leafs (4:30) and Penguins @ Mammoth (6:00). Covers and Dimers disagree on both of the latter totals, so we only play one small edge.

straight.reasoning: Dimers' model gives Philly a 58.4% chance to lose by one or win, against 53.9% implied. The Flyers' offense is weak, but this only needs a close game. Quarter unit. Playable to -130.

sections.label: Basketball
sections.slate: WNBA Finals Game 2: Dream @ Valkyries, 5:00 PM PT on USA. Golden State won Game 1 68-64, with both teams shooting poorly (11-of-58 from three combined). Valkyries -2.5, total 152.5. Sources split three ways (Yahoo: Dream +2.5; Dimers: Valkyries ML and a big Over), and the Over looks too optimistic after a 132-point Game 1, so no bet. Game 3 is Wednesday in Atlanta. The NBA season tips off Tuesday.
